entities.summary: Karl Heinrich Emil Koch was a German botanist. He is best known for his botanical explorations in the Caucasus region, including northeast Turkey. Most of his collections have today been lost. He is also known as the first professional horticultural officer in Germany. The standard author abbreviation K.Koch is used to indicate this person as the author when citing a botanical name.
